thread:
jamie: Planning a small admin-prune next Thurs. Goal: reduce stale admin bindings and produce a replayable artifact for auditors. Need quick signoff on artifact layout.
park: +1. Can we keep it minimal: one signed tarball per principal with project IAM, key policies, bucket ACLs, notif history, and a manifest?
ise: Yes. Also include a short `prune-record.txt` with action timestamps and the person who executed the removal. Legal likes explicit provenance.
jamie: Example snapshot commands? paste pls.
ise: ```bash
# project bindings
gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJ --format=json > $PRINCIPAL-bindings.json
# KMS key policy (GCP)
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/$PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/$KR/cryptoKeys/$KEY --format=json > $KEY-iam.json
# AWS key policy
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id $KEY_ID --policy-name default > $KEY-aws-policy.json
# bucket ACLs
aws s3api get-bucket-acl --bucket $BUCKET > $BUCKET-acl.json
# recent binds/unbinds
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName:(SetIamPolicy BindRole) AND resource.labels.project_id=$PROJ" --limit 200 > $PROJ-bind-events.log
# bundle + checksum + gpg sign
sha256sum *.json *.log > manifest.sha256
tar czf evidence-$PRIN.tar.gz *.json *.log manifest.sha256
ngpg --detach-sign evidence-$PRIN.tar.gz
mc cp evidence-$PRIN.tar.gz s3://compliance-archive/$RUN_ID/
```
park: Add `repo-scan` to check IaC references before removing a role. If terraform/state references it, open owner ticket instead of prune.
ops-oncall: Ops will run a two-project canary Thu 02:00 UTC. During the window infra-agent will have `--deny-absent-role` enabled so deploys referencing removed roles fail fast. We'll collect traces to /var/log/priv-prune/$RUN_ID for 48h.
legal: Artifact format OK. Need tar.gz + manifest.sha256 + detached GPG signature. Retain 7 years. Include ticket ID and a one-line provenance statement inside the tarball.
pack-bot: PackBot: Created task CP-5209 "admin-prune evidence packaging" assigned to jamie, ise.
jamie: Recovery plan: if a service breaks we need a fast rebind path. Can we make `temp-grant --principal X --ttl 1h --reason "rollback"` that logs action and generates a signed artifact?
ops-oncall: Yes, we'll expose `temp-grant` in ops-tools and ensure it records a signed change-event to the same compliance bucket. We'll also wire CI smoke tests; failing smoke triggers `temp-grant` automatically.
ise: I'll add a `prune-record.txt` template and ensure each record includes executor, timestamp, PR/ticket link, and sha256 of the evidence tarball. Example line: `2026-03-29T02:05Z | remove-binding | principal:svc-123 | executor:jamie | evidence:sha256:abcd... | ticket:CP-5209`
park: Nice. One more: include a quick grep step for KMS usage in logs to catch silent failures: `gcloud logging read "textPayload:($PRIN) AND resource.type=kms_key" --limit 50`. If hits, escalate.
jamie: Good call. Action list: ise produce snapshot+pack script (PR), park add repo-scan rule, ops run canary Thu 02:00 UTC, legal confirm retention (done). Post PR & ticket links here.
pack-bot: PackBot: Task CP-5209 updated: evidence path s3://compliance-archive/5209/, retention 7y.
ops-oncall: We'll keep canary window short (5-10m per project) and monitor. If anything unexpected, revert with `temp-grant` and open P0.
jamie: Thanks all — brief updates only. Post artifacts to ticket when ready.
